events.title: Sunrise Desert Horse Ride
events.description: Early-morning group horse ride into the desert, 45 to 60 minutes, open to all levels. Arrive at the stable by 6:00; the ride sets off around 6:30. Booking by message to the organisers.

events.title: RAK Community Abend (German-speaking community evening)
events.price_text: AED 120 adults, AED 90 children 6–12, buffet and drinks included
events.description: Social evening for the German, Austrian and Swiss community with an international buffet and childcare. Registration from 17:30, buffet from 18:30; sign-up via online form.

deals.title: Live Sports & All-Day Happy Hour at Socials
deals.venue: Socials Tourist Restaurant & Bar, Mughal Suites, Al Mareedh St
deals.details: Live sport on multiple screens with the happy hour drinks menu all day; Indian, Mangalorean and Czech dishes.
